text: Great and effective deep tissue massage! My wife and myself went there twice and our therapist Tanny was very skillful. She took well care of our many pain points from working out all week. She has a great body feeling and she is massaging where it s much needed and not only following a program. She is also a very nice person so that we felt very comfortable. The room and ambiance is nice (sport physiotherapy style) and very clean. We have been looking for a serious massage on Samui for years and eventually we found one. The one hour deep tissue massage is rather on the more expensive side for Thailand standards, but worth evey Baht. Simple booking via WhatsApp. Highly recommended and we will be back next week.

Highly recommended for muscular problems. After struggling with a sore shoulder and knee for a while, I have already felt improvements after a few sessions with Ael. She knows exactly where to target and what to advise to work through the pain. You are instantly reassured you’re in good hands (literally) from Ael’s pressure application and you’ll be feeling better within an hour.

I visited Jory at Body Tune Up Sports Therapy Clinic with what I thought was a shoulder problem. After a thorough assessment, Jory quickly identified that the real issue was actually coming from my neck — something no clinic in the UK had managed to figure out, despite multiple visits. His expertise, clear explanations, and targeted treatment made a huge difference, and I felt genuine improvement straight away. I can’t recommend Jory enough — professional, knowledgeable, and results-driven. He sorted me out when no one else could.

This was the best massage I've recieved in all of thailand.  The therapist was professional and knew exactly what she was doing.  If you're injured or in pain, I highly recommend going to Body Tune Up.

I had two sessions with Jory, one focused on my hip mobility and the other on my back/shoulders. Both were exceptional.

Jory has immense knowledge and experience in his profession. He’s also a competitive padel player, which I believe helps him approach his physiotherapy practice with a better understanding of athleticism/performance.

During both sessions, Jory actively worked on my mobility issues, giving me a jump start on my healing journey, and then provided me with clear advice for continuing the work at home.

On top of everything, Jory is really friendly and easygoing and a pleasure to work with. Highly recommended to visit him!

After having chonic migrains for months, I finally found about Body Tune. Jory and his team are real magicians. I haven’t had a single migraine since the last consultation. I am so mind blow it’s the longest I’ve been without a migraine. It’s changing my life, my work, my mood, social life… everything! THANK YOU SO MUCH! I couldn't recommend their services more.

I first visited Body Tune Up with really bad hip and lower back pain caused by muscle spasms. Jory, the physiotherapist, quickly assessed and treated the issue, and gave me effective exercises to continue at home. I was genuinely amazed at the improvement after just one session—it got me back to work the next day! His knowledge of anatomy and movement is exceptional, and the clinic is spotless and professional.

Update – July 2025:
I’ve also been seeing Khun Bow for deep tissue massage, and she’s fantastic. After just two sessions, I’ve noticed a big release in muscle tightness around my lower back and hips. Highly recommend if you’re after proper bodywork.

The clinic is super clean, calm, and really professional. There’s parking, a toilet/change room too, so it’s all really convenient.

I had an amazing experience with Jory and his team. I first came to Jory with a running injury, and he immediately gave me a set of daily exercises that really helped. Later on, I met with a sports massage therapist who treated my body and made sure I was ready for my race.

On my last visit, I even had the chance to work with a guest therapist from Bangkok, who gave me professional treatment and exercises that are perfect for runners like me. As someone who runs regularly, I know how important it is to take care of my body—and thanks to this team, I feel supported and in great hands.

After a complex knee injury, I came to Tanny, and after several sessions in which she treated me with dedication and professionalism, significant improvement began to occur in knee function, movement, and leg strength. Recommended!

Jory Serota is really a professional Specialist! He has helped me with my injured leg. Quickly spotted the root of the problem and fixed it. I was 100% better even after just one visit! Highly recommend him and his work ❤️ I wish there is more specialist like him everywhere.

Highly recommend Jory! His in depth knowledge and years of experience ensures a safe, professional assessment before providing support and effective treatment and exercises that don’t just provide relief from symptoms but aim to address the core problems that patients may experience.

The fact Jory is such a champion of a human being with a great sense of humour is just an added bonus!

I could not recommend him highly enough as a very active person.
Mr Jory is exceptionally skilled and has a truly remarkable touch. I would highly recommend him to anyone seeking treatment for a sports injury.

Jory is awesome! Very knowledgeable and precise. He helped me after abdominal surgery and fixed my back and neck pain. Massage, manipulations and home exercises were all explained very well. Do not hesitate to see him. He is an absolute star. World class!

Due to an unfortunate accident I had a torn shoulder and all the doctors recommended an expensive surgery with prolonged recuperation period. After careful consideration I elected the nonsurgical path with the professional physical therapy by Jory Serota. I'm so happy I chose this option as Jory helped me and my shoulder to get back to 99% of its normal function. I'm confident that I can regain most if not all of the remaining 1% in the coming months. Jory is professional and experienced physical therapist. I can wholeheartedly recommend him to anyone looking for similar treatments!

Jory is fantastic. He has helped my mobility to where I no longer feel like my spine is imbedded in concrete. The exercises are simple but Jory makes the complex simple!
Highly recommend Jory 👍 …

I visited Jory for back pain in the lumbar spine that has been accompanying me for several weeks already. Within one hour Jory was able to undo what I thought would take weeks or months to fix. With clever tests, he found my imbalances and taught the compensating muscles to relax. I came back for another session, as my spine still seemed to be a bit stiff. Both times he showed me exercises that I can do at home to help my back recover while filming me with my phone so I would remember at home. I can recommend everybody with problems with their joints or muscles to consult Jory, as he’s world class in what he does! He even teaches the Neuro Kinetic Therapy worldwide! There’s no excuse to not get your issues fixed while being on Koh Samui!
To Jory: thanks again, mate! I also enjoyed our conversations a lot! Wish you all the best for your future endeavors!

Learnt some new movements to aid my back issues, L4-L5 slipped disc(left side)  facet joint syndrome from L3-SI joint(right side). These movements even tho I only had 5 session whilst in Koh Samui, Thailand, I could feel the benefits and understanding of how these movements will help my lower back.
Highly appreciated the work I did with Jory and would recommend his services to anyone. A good guy and very knowledgable and able to see thru “my self convinced” routine that I thought was good for me and able to explain why I should even stop certain routines as they were too advance at my current condition.
Will definitely keep him updated too as I believe it will help me further and faster.

Amazing deep tissue massage. My elbow ache is gone...felts really proffessional but also a lot of laughs during. I'll be back for sure

I went through some intense physio with Jory as I had limited time in Samui. He has made unbelievable progress with me after I fractured my spine.

I've seen many physiotherapists in my life and none with the knowledge and experience quite like Jory.

I would highly recommend him.

Jory is a magician when it comes to sports related injuries. I had a long standing bursitis problem in my shoulder that he solved in one session, with a very detailed explanation of the injury and what exercises to do to strengthen and prevent it happening again.
I thoroughly recommend him as a therapist/physio for any sports loving person.

I've visited a lot of chiropractors, osteopaths, and similar specialists in my life, so I can say with confidence that the owner really knows what he's doing.
On the first day, he had no free time, so I went to the girls and was very pleasantly surprised by the quality of the massage. The price was 1,000 baht. The girls don't do manual therapy, so the next day I went to the owner. He spent 15 minutes diagnosing the problem and then solved it in literally 5 minutes.
In total, I paid a little under $100, but it was definitely worth it.
